thread:
anya (PM): Shared a trimmed prototype that combines the roles matrix with a compact invite drawer. Main ask: ensure SSO enforcement is discoverable and accessible. Figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-invite-2150

sam (Designer): The compact layout looks cleaner. Concern: SSO enforcement currently appears as tiny helper text under the role name. It reads like metadata rather than a policy.

lee (Frontend): We can convert that helper into a pill + info icon. Making the pill keyboard-focusable should improve discoverability.

lu (a11y): Accessibility notes: 1) Pill must meet 4.5:1 contrast. 2) When a role that requires SSO is selected, SR should announce "Selected role: X. Requires SSO." 3) Ensure focus returns to the invite button after closing any modal.

pete (Backend): Backend needs to add `sso_required` boolean to roles API and include an `event_id` in invite responses for audit deep-linking. No problem to add.

lee (Frontend): Proposal: badge text "SSO only" (short). Info icon opens modal with details. Use `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and trap focus. Add `aria-live="polite"` region for announcements.

sam (Designer): Copy options for the pill: "SSO only", "Requires SSO", "Enforced". I prefer "SSO only" for brevity. Tooltip copy: "Users must sign in with your org SSO to use this role."

lu (a11y): Agree on pill text. For SR announce, set `aria-describedby` on the selected role to the live region text node. Also make the pill reachable by keyboard but not first in tab order to avoid noise. Tab order should be: [email input] -> [role selector] -> [SSO pill/info] -> [send invite].

lee (Frontend): Noted. Also keyboard navigation through roles: arrow keys to move rows, Enter to select. We'll add `role="row"` and `aria-rowindex`. Focus outlines on the full row help sighted keyboard users.

pete (Backend): On audit deep-linking: we'll support `?highlight=invite:<event_id>&context=modal` so frontend can scroll and flash the item. We'll return event_id on invite create.

anya (PM): UX ask: when deep-link from modal, show a small chip near filters: "From invite modal" and pulse the matched row for 1.5s. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

sam (Designer): I'll update the figma to show the pill as filled with high contrast, add the info modal frames, and include the chip in audit flows.

lee (Frontend): I'll implement the pill, SR live region, arrow-key row nav, and deep-link highlight handler. Will make the pulse conditional on reduced-motion.

lu (a11y): After PR, I'll do a quick screen-reader pass and keyboard-only test. Also check color contrast on mobile.

ci-bot: note: UI change flagged small; no CI infra changes required.

anya (PM): Thanks team. Target: API update and figma today, frontend PR tomorrow, a11y review after. Ping here if any blocking issues.
